snapshot.title: The Ascent of Karl — reinvent history, badly

attributes.aria-label: Summer 1 of 50 — every attempt costs one

children.text: Every great story begins somewhere. This one begins with a shivering man staring at a rock as if it owed him money. Onward, humanity.
Combine two elements to write what happens next.

attributes.aria-label: Karl is freezing. It's cold on the steppe. Karl's goosebumps have goosebumps.

children.text: Nothing matches that. Karl checked twice.
